# IPC reference

The daemon listens on a local socket. Each request and each response is one JSON object on one line.

Request: `{"id": 1, "method": "<name>", "params": {...}}`

Response: `{"id": 1, "result": <value>}` on success, or `{"id": 1, "error": "<message>"}` on failure.

Errors are plain strings. Unknown methods return `unknown method: <name>`. Bad params return `bad params: <reason>`. Other messages come from the daemon manager.

## Methods

| Method | Params | Result | Errors |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ping` | none | [PingResult](#pingresult) | `error` string |
| `shutdown` | none | null | `error` string |
| `list_instances` | none | [InstanceView](#instanceview)[] | `error` string |
| `add_instance` | [CfgParams](#cfgparams) | string | `error` string |
| `update_instance` | [CfgParams](#cfgparams) | null | `error` string |
| `remove_instance` | [IdParams](#idparams) | null | `error` string |
| `start_instance` | [IdParams](#idparams) | null | `error` string |
| `stop_instance` | [IdParams](#idparams) | null | `error` string |
| `restart_instance` | [IdParams](#idparams) | null | `error` string |
| `get_logs` | [IdParams](#idparams) | string[] | `error` string |
| `start_all` | none | null | `error` string |
| `stop_all` | none | null | `error` string |
| `get_settings` | none | [GetSettingsResult](#getsettingsresult) | `error` string |
| `set_settings` | [SetSettingsParams](#setsettingsparams) | null | `error` string |
| `detect_claude_bin` | none | string \| null | `error` string |

Tauri GUI commands mirror these names with camelCase args. The GUI exposes `ping` as `daemon_info` and `shutdown` as `stop_daemon`.

## Types

### CfgParams

Params of `add_instance` and `update_instance`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cfg` | [InstanceConfig](#instanceconfig) | yes |  |

### GetSettingsResult

Result of `get_settings`. `autostart` is always `null`: the GUI owns login autostart.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `autostart` | null | yes |  |
| `claudeBin` | string \| null | yes |  |

### IdParams

Params of `get_logs`, `remove_instance`, `start_instance`, `stop_instance`, `restart_instance`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |  |

### InstanceConfig

One folder that runs `claude remote-control`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `autoStart` | boolean | yes |  |
| `autoTrust` | boolean | yes |  |
| `capacity` | integer \| null | yes |  |
| `chrome` | boolean | yes |  |
| `createSessionInDir` | boolean \| null | yes |  |
| `extraArgs` | string[] | yes | Extra arguments for `claude remote-control`. |
| `folder` | string | yes | Folder that `claude remote-control` runs in. |
| `id` | string | yes | Stable id. Empty on `add_instance`: the daemon generates one. |
| `name` | string \| null | yes |  |
| `permissionMode` | string \| null | yes | One of `acceptEdits`, `auto`, `bypassPermissions`, `default`, `dontAsk`, `plan`. |
| `sessionNamePrefix` | string \| null | yes |  |
| `spawn` | string \| null | yes | One of `same-dir`, `worktree`, `session`. |
